research_scope: Heroic Assault — Strike Super / conditional melee counter research and Counter Skills catalog reconciliation.

verification_audit.method: Compared current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation, current Counter Skill taxonomy, Dragon Ball reference documentation, official Dragon Ball DLC documentation, and the all-184 Parallel Quest guide.

duplicate_check.repository_history_search: No prior dedicated Heroic Assault research batch was found.
duplicate_check.identity_note: Canonical identity is Super / Strike. Counter behavior is represented separately as a conditional melee-counter characteristic.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Heroic Assault is a Strike Super. Current Counter Skill documentation lists it under Melee Counter specifically when the user is attacked during the rush. The individual Heroic Assault page categorizes it only under Strike Supers, so the repository should preserve both facts without inventing a separate Counter class.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Parallel Quest 156 — Hunting Down Dr. Hedo. The all-184 PQ guide lists Heroic Assault under PQ156 Basic Reward. Dragon Ball Wiki also states that the Future Warrior can randomly obtain it from PQ156.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Heroic Assault is Gamma 1's Super Skill from Hero of Justice Pack 1. The official Dragon Ball site describes the move and its counter behavior as part of Gamma 1's DLC moveset.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required is false because the reviewed all-184 PQ guide explicitly lists Heroic Assault under PQ156 Basic Reward rather than an Ultimate Finish reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The skill page documents 100 Ki. No reliable stamina cost or drop probability was established, so those fields remain null.
verification_audit.availability_finding: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies the Future Warrior as an obtainable user, supporting usable_by_cac true.
verification_audit.taxonomy_discrepancy: Heroic Assault is explicitly present on the current Counter Skill subtype page but is absent from the current Category:Counter Skills listing reviewed during this project. This is treated as a documentation/category inconsistency, not a reason to omit the skill from the canonical skill record.

records.name: Heroic Assault
records.source_quest_or_shop: Parallel Quest 156 — Hunting Down Dr. Hedo
records.ultimate_finish_evidence: The all-184 Parallel Quest guide lists Heroic Assault under PQ156 Basic Reward.
records.skill_description: Rush toward the opponent; additional input can perform a tackle, while being attacked during the charge causes Gamma 1 to dodge and fire a backflip counter shot.
records.mechanics_notes: The official Dragon Ball description confirms the rush, optional tackle input, and counter shot when attacked during the charge. Current Counter Skill taxonomy classifies the attacked-during-rush behavior as a melee counter. The individual skill page classifies the canonical skill as a Strike Super.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ156 is the documented Future Warrior route. The exact random-drop probability is unresolved.
records.pve_notes: PQ156 Basic Reward evidence establishes no Ultimate Finish requirement for the documented reward slot.
records.pvp_notes: The counter property only applies to the attacked-during-rush state. Additional input can also extend the move without requiring the counter to trigger; exact frame data is not encoded.
